column1: # math lexicon: form (lowercase) <TAB> class <TAB> argument. build.rs compiles it into a constant
# match (lex::lookup): at run time rules compare enums, not strings. A duplicate form is a build error.
# Classes: num n[/d] — numeral; mult n — multiplier (hundred); dozen; frac n/d — fraction (half); times n — «twice»;
# unit U — unit (UnitW variant); scale S — temperature scale; degree; pct; op O; fn F; kw K.
